metadata.title: 交互に出口が変わる回路で列を再生し、全ての状態を元に戻す
metadata.summary: 出口が交互に変わる二分木を使い、指定列を再生する。不要な葉の部分木を取り除き、最初に原点へ戻るときに全てのスイッチを初期状態へ戻す。
aliases: IOI2018 Mechanical Doll shared alternating router
bit reversal pruned complete binary switch circuit

metadata.family: 状態を持つ回路の構築

reference.title: Mechanical Doll
reference.evidence: 初期Xの二出口スイッチが通過ごとにX/Yを反転し、状態を持たないトリガーの指定列を初回原点復帰まで正確に再現し、その時に全スイッチをXへ戻す構築である。全トリガーと原点の出口を一つの分岐木へ共有し、N+1個の出力A+[0]をビット反転訪問順に置く。不要葉を空間的な先頭へ集め、全葉が不要な部分木を根への辺で置き換えると、残る状態遷移と出力を保ちながらスイッチ数をN+log2N以内へ減らせる。
reference.verificationNotes: 2026-10-15に原典5頁・公式Review2頁・後年のTomasz Idziaszek公開解答をwebで再読。主催SYR原典p4検索本文でM1..100000/N1..200000/A1..M・重複可・満点S<=N+log2Nを確認。hard400000/20000000と有効番号[-S,M]は英語原典/主催英語・LVA p5で確認。SYR p5検索本文には2000000との表記が出たため、その検索表示を20m根拠へ流用していない。画像未読なので翻訳原文の誤植か検索抽出の欠字かは断定しない。日本委員会公式日別一覧で本番2018-09-05、難度不明はnull。公式Reviewの全出口共有と不要葉集約の方針を参照し、bit反転順、削除部分木の動作射影、最後のP−1葉だけを原点へ置く初回停止、全X復元、S=sum ceil((N+1)/2^j)=N−popcount(N)+h、T=sum2^j ceil((N+1)/2^j)<=P*hを独立証明。公式Reviewと後年の著者補足を区別しindependent-analysisとした。実MDX単一可視C++20を抽出し-O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror、通常/ASan+UBSanで検証。M1..4/N1..8全97738列、二記号N9..16全130560列をliteral toggle simulatorへ渡し、符号付き装置番号と現在出口使用後の反転だけで実行。bit反転/刈込の式を実行oracleに使わない。各回路で2周期を同じ実状態から連続実行し、全出力を逐次比較、初回0までの正確なN到着、全割当スイッチの最終X/正偶数通過、全C/X/Yの参照範囲を確認。全N1..200000では各高さの整数区画数によるS/Tとpopcount恒等式/満点/hard両予算を比較し、全Nの実配線構築を行ったとは主張しない。実配線はN1..2048全長、80二冪近傍、300乱択、最大N200000の定数/昇順周期/逆順周期/乱択4例で構築/シミュレート。最大M100000、未使用トリガー、重複、N1/二冪境界を含む。invalid builder12呼出し、交互50回再構築/値コピーの独立性、全X開始契約とN1開始Y反例を確認。117243125 checks、461464周期、15279956トリガー出力、累計180979888状態変化。最大一周期3836286変化、最大実S200012。checksum17302177393877592427。通常1.03119秒/RSS8332KiB、ASan+UBSan3.19943秒/RSS500952KiB、同一件数/checksumで成功。LeakSanitizerのみptrace環境のため無効。共有/初回auditは未変更。

problemFeature.title: Mechanical Doll
features: 一出口の原点とトリガー、全Xから通過ごとにX/Yを交互選択する二出口スイッチの配線を構築する。同じトリガーの反復、任意個の入口、根への再入が可能。
初回原点復帰までに指定トリガー列を正確に出し、その時に全スイッチをXへ戻す。
problemFeature.notes: 初期Xの二出口スイッチが通過ごとにX/Yを反転し、状態を持たないトリガーの指定列を初回原点復帰まで正確に再現し、その時に全スイッチをXへ戻す構築である。全トリガーと原点の出口を一つの分岐木へ共有し、N+1個の出力A+[0]をビット反転訪問順に置く。不要葉を空間的な先頭へ集め、全葉が不要な部分木を根への辺で置き換えると、残る状態遷移と出力を保ちながらスイッチ数をN+log2N以内へ減らせる。

sourceBounds.initialState: every switchX; use current exit THEN flip
sourceBounds.firstReturn: exactly N trigger entries equal A; all switchesX

api.originalAdapter: build(M,A), then call answer(c.trigger_exit,c.x,c.y) once. The construction function itself performs no I/O or callback.
api.errors: invalid_argument for invalid M, empty/oversized N, out-of-range trigger serial; standard allocation exceptions propagate.
api.executionContract: start at origin0 with every switch inX. No execution-state parameter is accepted by the construction API; arbitraryY initial states are outside its guarantee.
api.stateReuse: all construction state local; no static/global caches. Returned vectors are independently owned values.
api.numbering: root-1; trigger_exit[0..M] all-1; switch-j exits x[j−1]/y[j−1]; all refs within[-S,M]
integerSafety: switch count<=200017; negative serials safely within int
all index/size conversions occur after source bounds validation
no large products except state-count proof; T<=4718592, exact validator uses uint64
api.recursion: balanced subdivision, at mosth+1<=19 frames; no unbounded recurrence

proof.bitReversal: At root visit t (zero based), first branch is t bit0, next is bit1, etc. Complete-tree leaf is the reversal of h bits.
proof.projection: In the complete tree all killed leaves return to root. Every entry into an all-killed subtree emits no trigger and returns to root. Replacing that traversal by a direct root edge removes only deleted switch changes; projected visits and states of retained switches are unchanged.
proof.firstOrigin: Last complete-tree visit is leafP−1, always alive. Only that leaf is0; all earlier live leaves positive and dead subtrees negative root. Hence the first origin return is exactly after all P leaf attempts and N outputs.
proof.reset: Each retained internal node j levels above leaves is visited2^j times per complete period, an even number. Projection preserves these counts; all retained statesX at first return.
proof.switchCount: RightmostK=N+1 leaves intersect exactlyceil(K/2^j) aligned blocks at levelj. S=sumceil(K/2^j)=h+sumfloor(N/2^j)=N−popcount(N)+h.
proof.fullScore: h=floorlog2N+1; popcountN>=1 implies S<=N+floorlog2N<=N+log2N for every N>=1.
proof.repeat: All statesX and ball at origin are the full initial state, so next cycle repeats the same A.

complexity.constructionTime: O(M+Nlog(N+1)); P<2(N+1), bit reversalPh and tree buildingO(S)

verification.allNIntegerBudgetScope: N1..200000 use independent level block-count arithmetic vs popcount identity, full-score/hard S/T inequalities. This does NOT claim every one of those large circuits was built/simulated.
verification.oracle: Literal ball at serial0 follows C for origin/positive trigger, follows current X/Y for a negative switch then flips it. No bit reversal/pruning/count formula decides the next device. Stop at FIRST return0; compare every emitted trigger to A and every allocated switch state/visit parity. Run2 periods without replacing the machine state.
otherChecks: all output C/X/Y lengths and valid serial ranges, unused trigger exit assignment
actual S vs level geometric count, actual state changes vs geometric T
N1, duplicate labels, all equal labels, rare/unseen labels, every nearby power-of-two length
invalid M INT_MIN/-1/0/100001/INT_MAX; empty/200001 length; A INT_MIN/-1/0/M+1/INT_MAX
50 interleaved fresh builds, independently owned copied vectors
builder has no execution-state input; N1 allY would return origin prematurely, illustrating the explicit allX contract
